sloka: हनुमन्तं कपिं व्यक्तं मन्यते नान्यथेति सा ।अथोवाच हनूमांस्तामुत्तरं प्रियदर्शनाम् ।। ५.३५.८७।।।।
transliteration: hanumantaṁ kapiṁ vyaktaṁ manyate nānyatheti sā ।athovāca hanūmāṁstāmuttaraṁ priyadarśanām ।। 5.35.87।।।।

translations.english: She realised that the monkey was none other than Hanuman. Then he looked at her who was pleasing to see and spoke again:
